BRACKLEY RESERVOIR · ROUTINE SAMPLING · JUNE 2032
Laboratory copy. Not for release.

sample   date     lead (µg/l)   limit   result
BR-061   3 Jun    8             10      pass
BR-062   10 Jun   31            10      FAIL
BR-063   17 Jun   44            10      FAIL
BR-064   24 Jun   47            10      FAIL

Lab note: three fails in a row. Source is the old feeder main at Harlow Lane. Supply should be stopped and households told today.

Reply from operations, 25 Jun: supply stays on. Retest in the autumn. Do not write to households. Do not send this to the regulator until legal has seen it.

Nothing was sent to the regulator.

CHAIN OF CUSTODY. Brackley supply, June 2032.

Samples 1 to 6 collected 14:00. Samples 7 to 9 collected 16:30. Sample 7 is not in the lab register. Samples 7 to 9 were not tested. A note in the margin says “result not required.” The note is in pencil.

Call with the regulator, 8 March. They asked for the 2032 returns in full. We said they would be sent. The returns are in a file called regulator_returns_2032.dat, which is not the file we would send, because the one we would send is a different file with the same name.

TESSERA WATER · INVESTOR RELATIONS · FILE NOTE

14 Oct 2033   Chief engineer's disposal plan adopted: 15 March each year, 10% of holding, no discretion.
15 Mar 2034   Plan executed on schedule.
18 Mar 2034   Contamination report filed with the regulator.

IR log: three calls this week from H. Marlow (Anvil Capital), each asking for "the date the engineer sold". Anvil has held a short position in the stock since 9 March (public filing).
